title: Constant-Time Byte-Slice Equality (branchless trace depends on n)
contract_header:
use eq = "ct_eq_spec.ode"

fn ct_bytes_eq(a: n bytes, b: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n < 18446744073709551615
    returns eq.bytes_eq(a, b)
    trace depends on n
    stack 0
task_summary: Implement and verify constant-time byte-slice equality `ct_bytes_eq` whose execution trace depends only on the length `n` (never on the contents of `a` or `b`).
